summary: A dataset opened from Project Instance now shows the Origin and Development Length it was saved with, even when its figures are stored finer underneath.
details: A hand-entered triangle imported from ResQ at a yearly display over monthly figures opened as 12/1 and could not be put back to 12/12, because the open reported the file's own shape as the displayed one.
The open now rolls the stored figures up to the saved display shape, shows the stored period beside each length, and keeps the coarse-view note on the status line.
